positions.title: iOS Application Developer
positions.description: Eywhere helps you link your friends everywhere and share all your usernames at the same time!

positions.title: iOS Application Developer
positions.description:
Helped to Develop 13 different iOS Applications (GameBin, InviteAndMeet, etc.).

Presented Documentation and Got Back End Development Team up to speed on what to do Server Side for iOS Push Notifications.

Collaborated with Lead Developer on Algorithms that lead to better efficiency, many times going from Big O Notation O(N^2) to O(N).

Presented iOS Applications to Non Technical Clients and Helped Them to Better Understand.

positions.title: Mobile Application Developer
positions.description:
Single Handedly Developed 2 New iOS Applications and 2 New Android Applications. (LeoAffairs For iOS/Android and PopularMilitary for iOS/Android). These News apps have features such as Push Notifications, Feeds and Offline Viewing using Core Data.

Helped to support, add features to, and maintain a private email network. Worked to develop a way of ensuring that customers would only be able to exchange emails within their private network (The Bright Network for iOS, Android and Web).

Built an automatic Payment Renewal System for The Bright Network that brought revenues up by 500% (Java and The Play Framework).

Created a Custom "Popular Posts" Wordpress Plugin to highlight Posts getting more engagement. This helped to increase traffic to Bright Mountain's many websites.

Collaborated with Lead Developer to create a Custom Sales Report System. This helped The Finance and Accounting Team work much more efficiently.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Published Blogs that increased Website Traffic and fixed any Website Bugs stumbled upon (Wordpress, HTML, CSS, Javascript).

Got HubSpot Certified and created Engaging Content to attract customers. This helped to increase site traffic by 100% (Inbound Marketing, Graphic Design, Video Production, etc.).

positions.title: iOS Application Developer
positions.description:
Totally Designed User Interface and Developed iOS Application for Rhyming Game (Objective C.)
 
Created Database of Rhyming Words and Algorithm for Knowing if two words Rhyme in generally O(N). 

Used AVSpeechSynthesizer to have Siri's voice "speak" Rhymes as you play the game.

Implemented Google's Admob Ads and iOS's In App Purchases to boost up revenues.

positions.title: Mobile Application Developer
positions.description:
Completely Designed and Developed both an iOS Application and Android Application (Objective C/Swift on iOS and Java on Android).

Added features such as Audio Playback, Shuffle, Background Play, Search Filter, Social Sharing and Custom PlayList Creation.

Set Up With Google Analytics SDK to better understand how app gets used.

Implemented Google's Admob Ads to boost up revenues.

positions.title: Mobile Application Developer
positions.description:
Helped to Develop Social Networking WebSite and Mobile Applications for iOS and Android (PHP, Objective C, Java). 

Oversaw Quality Assurance and worked to Fix Bugs in Collaboration with Lead Developer and CEO.
